rationale: The brief must draw on the portfolio description, the fraud exploration, both modelling tasks and at least one provider or denial analysis, but the request does not map T1-T7 to those topics, so all seven sources are collected; the component records absent sources as missing rather than inventing values, so over-inclusion costs nothing while a subset risks omitting a required source. Sections are exactly the five the task specifies (methodology omitted to respect the 600-word cap for a non-technical sponsor). causal_language=avoid and cite_artifacts=true enforce the association-only wording and per-number [source: path] traceability the task demands. The report prints every rate as numerator/denominator, cites artifacts for each results bullet, and carries the synthetic-data and no-operational-use statements plus association, model-limitation, class-imbalance (fraud_pattern_type is populated on only 647/12845 claims, so the fraud label is rare) and small-group caveats relevant to synthesising provider/denial subgroup results. descriptive_only is excluded because the brief reports model results; sample_preview is excluded because T8 has no input tables.
